To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the point cloud based hull extraction is more accurate, but the image processing based approach is much faster.

for real world data, the point cloud approach is more accurate, but the image processing based approach is much faster, which makes it more suitable for large datasets, while for synthetic data, the point clouds based approach is more accurate and the image processing based is faster, but both are suitable for large datasets.
the image processing based approach is more efficient and the point cloud based more accurate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
generic approaches for the semantic reconstruction and annotation of 3D buildings from oblique and vertical imagery.
the development of a generic approach for the reconstruction of the hull of 2D structures from 3D point clouds or 2.5 D image based models.
the question, how to extract the hulls of buildings in a generic way, so that they can be used for further processing
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
both approaches are complementary and should be applied simultaneously.
the point cloud based reconstruction is superior in accuracy, but the image processing based one is superior in speed.
the 3D approach is superior for synthetic data and the image processing approach is superior for real world data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the image processing based approach is more suitable for real world data and for the extraction of semantic information from the 3D building reconstruction, whereas the point cloud based is more appropriate for the reconstruction of synthetic data and the extraction of geometric information from the 2.5 D surface models.
the 3D building reconstruction approach using the 3D points is more precise, but slower than using 2.5 D line segments.
the 3D reconstruction approach is superior for synthetic data and the image processing based approach is more appropriate for real world data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 3D hull of a building can be recovered from a single oblique or vertical aerial image.

a generic 3D reconstruction of buildings can be performed in an order of magnitude faster than the point cloud based reconstruction approach, while the accuracy of the reconstruction is sufficient to support the semantic annotation of the reconstructed building.
the image processing approach can be used to reconstruct the hulls of buildings with a sufficient accuracy for many applications.
